name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 30, 2019 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2019-10-30 Item 08A Warrants
8B.
Landscape Maintenance Services Agreement Amendment No. 5. Contact Person: Park Operations Manager Saul
City Council authorizes the City Manager to execute Amendment No. 5 with Excel Landscape for Citywide Landscape Maintenance Services, in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1, in consultation with the City Attorney, extending the agreement for an additional three-year term and for a total not to exceed $10,464,713 for the initial three-year term and the three-year extension.
2019-10-30 Item 08B Landscape Maintenane Services Amendment 5 - Excel Landscape
8C.
Notice of Completion for Pavement Rehabilitation and Roadway Sealing FY 2018-19 Project (CS19A), Encinitas Metal Beam Guardrail Project (CS19D), and General Mobility Improvements Project (CS18E). Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
1) Accept public improvements as complete; 2) Authorize release of performance bond and initiate warranty bond; and 3) Authorize filing of Notice of Completion.
2019-10-30 Item 08C Notice of Completion Pavement Rehabilitation and Roadway Sealing
8D.
Pavement Rehabilitation and Overlay Project FY 2018-2019 (CS19A). Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
City Council approve the project list of streets and specifications.
2019-10-30 Item 08D Pavement Rehabilitation and Overlay Project FY 2018-2019 (CS19A)
8E.
Agreement for Native Plant Restoration at Beacons Beach Bluff with Habitat Restoration Sciences. Contact Person: Park Operations Manager Saul
Staff recommends that City Council authorizes the City Manager to enter into a two-year agreement with Habitat Restoration Sciences for habitat restoration of Beacons Beach Bluff, in conjunction with the City Attorney in substantial form for an amount not to exceed $97,460.
2019-10-30 Item 08E Agreement for Native Plant Restoration at Beacons Beach Bluff with Habitat Restoration Sciences
8F.
Memorandum of Understanding Annual Holiday Banners and Downtown Lighting with Encinitas 101. Contact Person: Superintendent Ugrob
Authorize the City Manager to execute the new Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Encinitas 101, in conjunction with the City Attorney in substantial form, for Annual Holiday Banners and Downtown Lighting.
2019-10-30 Item 08F MOU Annual Holiday Banners and Downtown Lighting with Encinitas 101
8G.
Memorandum of Understanding with the Encinitas Union School District to implement a School Crossing Guard Pilot Program. Contact Person: Development Services Director Wisneski
1) Authorize the Mayor to execute a Memorandum of Understanding between the City of Encinitas and the Encinitas Union School District, in substantial form, to provide crossing guards at intersections near Ocean Knoll Elementary and Park Dale Lane Elementary for the 2019/2020 Fiscal Year; and 2) Adopt Resolution 2019-93, entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Adopted Budget” authorizing an appropriation of $18,000 to partially fund the Crossing Guard Pilot Program.
2019-10-30 Item 08G MOU with Encinitas Union School District to Implement a School Crossing Guard Pilot Program
8H.
Request to Reduce the Special Event Fee. Contact Person: Management Analyst Roff
The City Council authorizes the City Manager to reduce the Special Event Fee for Fill-A-Belly for the weekly community dinner service at Cottonwood Creek Park to a single annual fee of $300.
2019-10-30 Item 08H Request to Reduce the Special Event Fee
8I.
Agreement with Urban Corps of San Diego County and City of Encinitas for tree planting and maintenance. Contact Person: City Arborist Kallstrand
Authorize the City Manager to execute an agreement with Urban Corps, in conjunction with the City Attorney in substantial form, to plant and maintain 600 trees throughout the City of Encinitas under the CalFire Urban and Community Forestry Grant.
2019-10-30 Item 08I Agreement with Urban Corps of San Diego County - Tree Planting and Maintenance
2019-10-30 Item 08I Agreement with Urban Corps of San Diego County - Tree Planting - Amended Recommendation (Posted 10-30-2019)
8J.
Whale Tail Grant from the California Coastal Commission. Contact Person: Coastal Zone Administrator Timberlake
1) Approve a Resolution authorizing an application for grant funds from the Whale Tail Grants Program from the California Coastal Commission; and 2) Authorize the City Manager to enter into a grant agreement with the California Coastal Commission, in conjunction with the City Attorney, subject to future City Council budget appropriations.
2019-10-30 Item 08J Whale Tail Grant from the California Coastal Commission
8K.
Project Management Plan (PMP) with the San Diego Association of Governments (SANDAG) for construction of the El Portal Pedestrian and Bicycle Undercrossing Project (CS16F). Contact Person: Principal Engineer Bankston
1) Review and approve the Project Management Plan (PMP) with San Diego Association of Governments (SANDAG) (in substantial form as provided in Attachment 1) for construction of the El Portal Pedestrian and Bicycle Undercrossing Project;
2) Direct staff to pay $2,500,000 to SANDAG upon execution of the El Portal Pedestrian and Bicycle Undercrossing PMP;
3) Direct staff to pay $2,135,000 to SANDAG upon approval of the El Portal Pedestrian and Bicycle Undercrossing Project by the California Transportation Commission (CTC);
4) Authorize the City Manager to complete any and all activities necessary to transfer the construction portion of the Active Transportation Program grant to SANDAG;
5) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-90, entitled "A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2019-20 Budget" (Attachment 2) to re-allocate funds to the El Portal Pedestrian and Bicycle Undercrossing Project from the Streetscape Project and the RTCIP fund; and
6) Direct staff to include in the FY 2020-21 budget revise a budget re-allocation of $4 million to the Leucadia Streetscape Project (CS04D) from the El Portal Pedestrian and Bicycle Undercrossing Project (CS16F).
2019-10-30 Item 08K El Portal Project Management Plan with SANDAG
2019-10-30 Item 08K El Portal Project Management Plan with SANDAG - Amendment (Poasted 10-30-19)
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Amendments to City Council Policy No. C035: Small Wireless Facilities. Contact Person: City Planner Sapa'u
1) Receive the report and presentation by staff and Telecom Law Firm, City Wireless Facilities Special Legal Counsel; and 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2019-91 implementing amendments to City Council Policy C-035: Small Wire Facilities for the regulation of small wireless facilities and other infrastructure deployments in the public rights-of-way.

2019-10-30 Item 10A Small Cell Wireless - Attachment 4 Part 1
2019-10-30 Item 10A Small Cell Wireless - Attachment 4 Part 2 A
2019-10-30 Item 10A Small Cell Wireless - Attachment 4 Part 2 B
2019-10-30 Item 10A Small Cell Wireless - Attachment 4 Part 3 A
2019-10-30 Item 10A Small Cell Wireless - Attachment 4 Part 3 B

ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON NOVEMBER 13, 2019
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
